evaluation_components.component: Tutorial Tests (Best 4 of 6, to be announced beforehand)

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components.
makeup_policy: Make-up will be granted only when one has genuine reasons (illness requiring hospitalization or similar cases with medical certificate) for not appearing in the regular test. No make-up will be granted for the tutorial tests/surprise class tests/assignments.
